mapper.sql: p.id, p.author_id, a.display_name AS author_name, p.work_id, w.title AS work_title, p.topic, p.title,

TO_CHAR(p.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS created_at, TO_CHAR(p.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fl_forum_like l WHERE l.post_id = p.id) AS like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fl_forum_comment c WHERE c.post_id = p.id AND c.state = 'VISIBLE') AS comment_count, p.view_count, (SELECT i.image_key FROM fl_forum_image i WHERE i.post_id = p.id AND i.position = 0) AS preview_image, a.avatar_key
mapper.select:
SELECT DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(p.body, 220, 1) AS body, FROM fl_forum_post p JOIN fl_account a ON a.id = p.author_id LEFT JOIN fl_work w ON w.id = p.work_id
ORDER BY
comment_count DESC, like_count DESC, p.view_count DESC,
p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(p.body, 220, 1) AS body, , GREATEST(p.created_at, COALESCE(reply.last_reply, p.created_at)) AS active_at FROM fl_forum_post p JOIN fl_account a ON a.id = p.author_id LEFT JOIN fl_work w ON w.id = p.work_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT post_id, MAX(created_at) AS last_reply FROM fl_forum_comment WHERE state = 'VISIBLE' AND created_at >= SYSTIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '14' DAY GROUP BY post_id ) reply ON reply.post_id = p.id WHERE p.state = 'VISIBLE' AND p.screening_thread = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fl_community_setting WHERE id = 1 AND is_open = 1) AND (p.created_at >= SYSTIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '14' DAY OR reply.last_reply IS NOT NULL)
AND (w.work_type = #{type} OR (p.work_id IS NULL AND p.topic = #{type}))
ORDER BY active_at DESC, p.id DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT p.body, FROM fl_forum_post p JOIN fl_account a ON a.id = p.author_id LEFT JOIN fl_work w ON w.id = p.work_id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.state = 'VISIBLE' AND p.screening_thread = 0

SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.parent_id, pa.display_name AS reply_to, c.author_id, a.display_name AS author_name, c.body, TO_CHAR(c.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS created_at, a.avatar_key FROM fl_forum_comment c JOIN fl_account a ON a.id = c.author_id LEFT JOIN fl_forum_comment pc ON pc.id = c.parent_id AND pc.state = 'VISIBLE' LEFT JOIN fl_account pa ON pa.id = pc.author_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.state = 'VISIBLE' ORDER BY c.created_at, c.id OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
mapper.sql: c.id, c.thread_root_id AS root_id, c.parent_id, pa.display_name AS reply_to, CASE WHEN c.state = 'VISIBLE' THEN a.display_name END AS author_name, CASE WHEN c.state = 'VISIBLE' THEN a.avatar_key END AS avatar_key, CASE WHEN c.state = 'VISIBLE' THEN c.body END AS body, TO_CHAR(c.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS created_at, CASE WHEN c.state = 'VISIBLE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS removed, CASE WHEN c.parent_id IS NULL THEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fl_forum_comment r WHERE r.thread_root_id = c.id AND r.post_id = c.post_id AND r.state = 'VISIBLE' ) ELSE 0 END AS reply_count, CASE WHEN c.state = 'VISIBLE' THEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fl_screening_comment_like l WHERE l.comment_id = c.id ) ELSE 0 END AS like_count, CASE WHEN c.state = 'VISIBLE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fl_screening_comment_like l WHERE l.comment_id = c.id AND l.user_id = #{viewer,jdbcType=NUMERIC} ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS liked
JOIN fl_account a ON a.id = c.author_id LEFT JOIN fl_forum_comment pc ON pc.id = c.parent_id AND pc.state = 'VISIBLE' LEFT JOIN fl_account pa ON pa.id = pc.author_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fl_forum_comment c WHERE
SELECT FROM ( SELECT c.* FROM fl_forum_comment c WHERE ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY ) c ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC

SELECT FROM ( SELECT r.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.thread_root_id ORDER BY r.created_at, r.id) AS position FROM fl_forum_comment r WHERE r.post_id = #{postId} AND r.state = 'VISIBLE' AND r.thread_root_id IN #{id} ) c WHERE c.position <= 2 ORDER BY c.created_at, c.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fl_forum_comment c WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.thread_root_id = #{root} AND c.state = 'VISIBLE'
SELECT FROM fl_forum_comment c WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.thread_root_id = #{root} AND c.state = 'VISIBLE' ORDER BY c.created_at, c.id OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT r.id, r.target_type, r.target_id, COALESCE(p.id, c.post_id) AS post_id, CASE WHEN r.target_type = 'POST' THEN p.title || CHR(10) || DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(p.body, 500, 1) ELSE c.body END AS content, a.display_name AS reporter, r.reason, TO_CHAR(r.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS created_at FROM fl_forum_report r JOIN fl_account a ON a.id = r.reporter_id LEFT JOIN fl_forum_post p ON r.target_type = 'POST' AND p.id = r.target_id LEFT JOIN fl_forum_comment c ON r.target_type = 'COMMENT' AND c.id = r.target_id WHERE r.state = 'OPEN' ORDER BY r.created_at, r.id OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
